ryans.name: Ryan Vogel
ryans.title: Software engineer and founder; founding developer at OpenCode, the open-source coding agent, and founder of Inbound
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Vogel** is an American software engineer and founder. He is a founding developer at OpenCode, an open-source coding agent from Anomaly, and the founder of Inbound, a programmable email infrastructure service [1][2][3][5]. In October 2025, while listed as a developer advocate at Databricks, he gave a talk at Next.js Conf [10][11].
known_for: Founding Inbound, a programmable email API
